segments.he: עָבְרוּ אֵלּוּ וְלֹא נַעֲנוּ — מְמַעֲטִין בְּמַשָּׂא וּמַתָּן, בְּבִנְיָן וּבִנְטִיעָה. תָּנָא: בְּבִנְיָן — בִּנְיָן שֶׁל שִׂמְחָה. נְטִיעָה — נְטִיעָה שֶׁל שִׂמְחָה. אֵי זֶהוּ בִּנְיָן שֶׁל שִׂמְחָה — זֶה הַבּוֹנֶה בֵּית חַתְנוּת לִבְנוֹ. אִי זוֹ הִיא נְטִיעָה שֶׁל שִׂמְחָה — זֶה הַנּוֹטֵעַ אַבְּווֹרַנְקֵי שֶׁל מְלָכִים.
segments.en: § The mishna taught: «If these» fasts have passed «and they have not been answered, they decrease» their engagement «in» business «negotiations» and «in building and planting.» It was «taught» in the Tosefta (Megilla 5:2): «Building» means «joyful building,» not building in general. Likewise, «planting» means «joyful planting,» not all planting. The Tosefta elaborates: «What is joyful building? This» is referring to «one who builds a wedding chamber for his son.» It was customary upon the marriage of a son to build him a small house where the marriage feast was held and where the newlywed couple would live for a certain period of time. «What is joyful planting? This» is referring to «one who» plants «a splendid, royal garden» that does not serve practical purposes, but is only for ornamentation.
